result.reason: The addition reaches the fallback position: it provides a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, a 90-day material-conformance warranty for the Site and deliverables, compliance with applicable laws, protection against malicious code, and re-performance/repair/replacement/refund remedies. It preserves the existing representations and Globix provision and adds only the warranties needed. Drafting is generally professional, although “following acceptance” should be defined or tied to acceptance of each applicable deliverable, and the phrase “services and the Site will be performed and operated” is grammatically imprecise.
